title: Portrait social sequences
slide_intent: Adapt shared brand ingredients to a narrow screen so offers and stories remain legible in a social format.
strategic_value: Recurring bubbles, blue gradients and typography can connect O2 hardware offers, partner content and lifestyle messages.
demonstration: Three portrait story frames cycle through devices, partner entertainment and fitness offers, then an outdoor-life sequence; the middle frame repeatedly carries the O2 signature and bubbles.
practical_value: Compare product-led and image-led story layouts while retaining a recognizable central signature.

content_islands.name: Three portrait frames
content_islands.spec: Align three tall rounded story frames on a pale-blue field with equal gaps.

content_islands.name: Offer and lifestyle panels
content_islands.spec: Use the outer frames for devices or footage with headlines, supporting copy and small calls to action.

content_islands.name: Signature panel
content_islands.spec: Use the center frame for bubbles and the O2 mark, changing its field with the surrounding sequence.

reference_purposes.Expression: The changing panels repeat O2 blue, bubble forms and bold rounded headlines.
reference_purposes.Application: The clip shows the identity across portrait social-story promotions and lifestyle content.
